name: Important People of History: Presidents - Thomas Jefferson
source: Learn all about Thomas Jefferson in this visual novel biography containing rare photos of the room where the Declaration of Independence was signed, Jefferson’s Monticello home, and much more. Writer, Diplomat, President - this is Thomas Jefferson!
